name: decision-kit
description: Get an independent answer from one pinned OpenRouter decision model before a critical, security-relevant or low- or mid-confidence decision Claude made itself, and stop to ask the user on disagreement or uncertainty. The model can only add a stop, never authorize an action. Opt-in: needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY, sends screened excerpts under zero data retention, and fails closed for critical, security and high-risk decisions.
